profile.headline: Software Developer
profile.summary: Agile Software Engineer with a demonstrated history of working with and developing complex systems for enterprise software. Skilled in C#, .NET, SQL, maintenance, troubleshooting and more! Bachelors in Software Engineering from Florida Gulf Coast University. Currently a Software Developer for Kimley-Horn Technology Solutions.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.locationName: Raleigh, North Carolina, United States · On-site

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Developing new features and fixing bugs within .NET APIs, .NET Microservices,
Angular frontends and React frontends. Also responsible for designing a new
content management system, of which development is ongoing.

Recent work includes:
* Implementing a new system for updating user access hierarchies.
* Making improvements to various parts of the existing system as part of our
maintenance effort.
* Designing/Planning a new content management system.

positions.title: Team Lead
positions.description:
Led a cross-functional team in the design and development of an AI-powered resume screening tool as part of a strategic initiative to explore intelligent hiring solutions. Served as the architect and primary coordinator between the team and internal stakeholders, ensuring smooth execution from concept to delivery.
Key contributions:
* Defined project scope and technical requirements.
* Provided architectural oversight and mentorship on best practices.
* Aligned product outcomes with business needs.

positions.title: QA Engineer I
positions.description:
Began QA work on the team responsible for integrating our software with that of other large communication platforms. Then I moved to the team responsible for extending and maintaining the backend mining system.

Recently our work has included:
* Moving from SQL based search to Elastic search.
* Extending many applications to support cloud storage with Azure and AwsS3.
* Implementing OpenAI's embeddings with Vector database to support semantic searching.

positions.title: Project Lead
positions.description: For the purposes of a class project, I contacted and began work with Visions Elevator Inc. on a new "Job Quote" web tool. The goal of the project was to perform in depth business analysis, creating business rules, system requirements, software requirements, mock-ups, and complete SRS. Jira project management tools were used throughout the project, to organize and manage requirements and business rules as well as all technical documents. The project has since ended, but my work continues with Visions Elevator Inc. and it's CEO William Lafauci.

projects.title: findandreplace.net
projects.description: A free web tool made in React.js that allows users to do mass find & replace across multiple documents of different types. Can be used to update entire folders of documents, fill templates and more.

projects.title: Messaging App
projects.description:
With the intention of learning API design patterns, I began work on a .NET 6 Messaging API. I completed work on this API which includes CRUD operations on data such as Users and Messages, and supports the basic features of a messaging platform. This comes together in the React.js client to provide an experience that a user would expect from a messaging platform.

Many design choices were made to reduce coupling, improve security, and simplify error handling and logging.

The newest feature of this app is AI generated messages suggestions powered by OpenAI. I saw an opportunity to use OpenAI's API to improve a users capability for creating detailed and contextually relevant responses quickly and easily.
